mapper.select: SELECT SCH_CODE AS schCode FROM TB_SCHEDULE ORDER BY SCH_CODE DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SCH_CODE AS "schCode", SCH_NAME AS "schName" FROM TB_SCHEDULE WHERE SCH_USEYN = 'Y' ORDER BY SCH_NAME ASC

SELECT SCH_CODE AS schCode, SCH_NAME AS schName, SCH_STARTDAY AS schStartDay, SCH_ENDDAY AS schEndDay, GROUP_CODE AS groupCode, CONTENT_CODE AS contentCode, SCH_EMERGUBUN AS schEmerGubun, SCH_USEYN AS schUseYn FROM TB_SCHEDULE WHERE SCH_CODE = #{schCode}

SELECT A.SCH_CODE AS schCode, A.SCH_NAME AS schName, FN_DAYCONVERT(A.SCH_STARTDAY) AS schStartDay, FN_DAYCONVERT(A.SCH_ENDDAY) AS schEndDay, A.GROUP_CODE AS groupCode, A.CONTENT_CODE AS contentCode, A.SCH_EMERGUBUN AS schEmerGubun, A.SCH_USEYN AS schUseYn, fn_contentNm(A.CONTENT_CODE) AS "conNm", (SELECT B.GROUP_NM FROM TB_GROUP B WHERE A.GROUP_CODE = B.GROUP_CODE) AS groupNm FROM TB_SCHEDULE A WHERE 1=1 AND A.SCH_CODE = #{schCode}

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_SCHEDULE A JOIN TB_GROUP B ON A.GROUP_CODE = B.GROUP_CODE JOIN TB_CONTENTMUTIL C ON A.CONTENT_CODE = CAST(C.CON_SEQ AS VARCHAR) WHERE 1=1
AND A.GROUP_ID IN ( WITH RECURSIVE cte AS ( SELECT GROUP_ID, PARENT_GROUP_ID FROM LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} UNION ALL SELECT g.GROUP_ID, g.PARENT_GROUP_ID FROM LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO g JOIN cte ON g.PARENT_GROUP_ID = cte.GROUP_ID ) SELECT GROUP_ID FROM cte )
AND A.CENTER_ID = #{centerId}
AND A.SCH_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND A.SCH_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
SELECT SCH_CODE, GROUP_CODE FROM TB_SCHEDULE WHERE SCH_ENDDAY >= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') AND CONTENT_CODE = #{contentCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SCHEDULE ( SCH_CODE, SCH_NAME, SCH_STARTDAY, SCH_ENDDAY, GROUP_CODE, CONTENT_CODE, SCH_EMERGUBUN, SCH_USEYN, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, GROUP_ID, CENTER_ID ) VALUES ( fn_SCHCODE(), #{schName}, #{schStartDay}, #{schEndDay}, #{groupCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contentCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{schEmerGubun,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{schUseYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{mberId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{mberId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{groupId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{centerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SCHEDULE SET SCH_NAME = #{schName}, SCH_STARTDAY = #{schStartDay}, SCH_ENDDAY = #{schEndDay}, GROUP_CODE = #{groupCode}, CONTENT_CODE = #{contentCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SCH_EMERGUBUN = #{schEmerGubun,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SCH_USEYN = #{schUseYn}, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = NOW(), LAST_UPDUSR_ID = #{mberId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE SCH_CODE = #{schCode}
